end.summary:
Recognised equal parts in shapes and named halves, thirds and quarters in most attempts.
Initially compared parts taken with parts left when naming a fraction; later stated one piece out of four.
Found 1/2 of 8 and 1/3 of 12 correctly with sharing into equal groups.
Found 1/4 of 20 as 5 using four equal groups.
For 1/3 of 9 drumsticks as spares, continued exploring the grouping but did not finish the answer.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming fractions as equal parts of a whole and finding fractions of collections by making equal groups. Nisha correctly identified equal-sized parts, found one-third of 12 as 4 after distributing one banana to each friend in rounds, and found one-quarter of 20 as 5. They first mixed up parts taken with parts left, then corrected this by referring to the total number of pieces; the later drumstick question was not completed. At home, use small groups of objects and ask, “How many equal groups? How many in one group?”
